name: WFSW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created for the promotion's own debut pay-per-view and won there by Harlequin Tragedy in a twenty-man battle royal; he was still champion at the wing's last confirmed defense three months later, and this collection's own record does not reach a title change -- outside sources later call him a former champion, but not on any document served here.

name: WFSW United States Championship
epitaph: Deferred on the same night its first challengers were announced; already held by Mark "The Crippler" Baker by the promotion's next surviving broadcast, who was still champion, booked into a further defense, when this collection's own record breaks off.

name: WFSW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: First confirmed in the hands of The Returners at the promotion's next-to-last surviving broadcast, who kept the belts through its last; a different federation's own later broadcast billed a separate team as holding this title, a change this collection's own record does not itself capture.
